::: {.lede}
My work follows one chain of cause and effect: how the food we eat is recorded
in the epigenome of fat tissue, how that record sets the tissue's capacity to
store energy, and how that capacity shapes long-term health and aging.
*(Draft scaffold — prose below to be written/approved by Philip; no claims published without sign-off.)*
:::
